# Tested Agent Skills

> Tested Agent Skills started in Claude Code. It includes 35 Agent Skills entries, 26 native Claude Code subagents, and matching portable role briefs. Codex can install the Markdown skills. Two entries use Claude Code command or delegation conventions.

Skills are Markdown folders in the Agent Skills format. The guides below show how to install the specific skills you need. Historical quality comparisons used Claude models. The Codex smoke test checks session execution.

## Start here

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliomachadome/tested-agent-skills/main/README.md): Project overview, focused installation commands, compatibility summary and license.
- [Installation script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliomachadome/tested-agent-skills/main/scripts/install.sh): Links selected skills and, for Claude Code, native agents. Use `--dry-run` before changing a machine.
- [Skill index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliomachadome/tested-agent-skills/main/SKILLS.md): Every skill, its purpose and path.
- [Catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliomachadome/tested-agent-skills/main/CATALOG.md): English discovery catalog with evaluation status.

## Harness guides

- [Claude Code guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliomachadome/tested-agent-skills/main/docs/claude-code.md): Focused install, native agents, context controls, updates and safety boundaries.
- [Codex guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliomachadome/tested-agent-skills/main/docs/codex.md): Focused install, portable role briefs and isolated smoke testing.
- [Compatibility](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliomachadome/tested-agent-skills/main/docs/compatibility.md): Exact support level and evidence boundary for each environment.
- [Loading, cost and safety boundaries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliomachadome/tested-agent-skills/main/docs/loading-and-cost.md): Progressive loading, context cost and permission limits.

## Roles and evaluation

- [Portable agent profiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliomachadome/tested-agent-skills/main/agent-profiles/README.md): Use the 26 role profiles outside Claude Code.
- [Evaluation methodology](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliomachadome/tested-agent-skills/main/docs/evaluation-methodology.md): What the historical Claude-based results measure and what they do not.
- [Evaluation summary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliomachadome/tested-agent-skills/main/docs/evaluation-summary.md): Aggregate historical results and limits.
- [Public fixtures](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliomachadome/tested-agent-skills/main/evals/public/README.md): Synthetic fixture rules and safe result reporting.

## Trust and participation

- [Security and privacy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliomachadome/tested-agent-skills/main/SECURITY.md): Release, installation and evaluation boundaries.
- [Attribution](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliomachadome/tested-agent-skills/main/ATTRIBUTION.md): CC BY-SA credit templates for projects, products and agents.
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliomachadome/tested-agent-skills/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Evidence, licensing, safety and cross-harness contribution rules.
